expected.method: ts = tan 9 deg, td = tan 2.5 deg. Section area A = 6*14 - ts*9.8^2/2. The drafted ceiling z = 10 - x td meets the 9 deg ceiling z = 10 + (-4.2 - x) ts at xc = -4.2 ts/(ts - td) = -5.798416753. Inside (width 3) the draft removes 3 [td xc^2/2 - ts (-4.2 - xc)^2/2]; on the pad (width 2) 2 td 4.2^2/2. V(pad) = 3A + 2*4.2*6 - both; V(no pad) = 3A - the inside part.
expected.what: Profile in x-z extruded 3 along +y: ceiling z = 10 for x in [-4.2, 0], a second ceiling rising at 9 deg toward -x for x in [-14, -4.2], top z = 16; a 4.2 x 2 x 6 pad joined on the y = 0 side under the flat ceiling, so the ceiling is one face running across the wall line y = 0 onto the pad. The ceiling drafted -2.5 deg about x = 0 (pull +x) rises toward -x: inside it grows until it meets the 9 deg ceiling, outside it lifts the pad's end; it met the wall y = 0 only at a vertex and now needs an edge with it. Refused 'not a closed solid': the corner (four planes, one concave edge) was not split.
